counter_witness.origin: atomic zero at Comfort entry while capture tail is closed

rows.action: cold boot product, mount library physically, require v16core and repl-comfort, then submit (repl)
rows.expect: both requires return t and the distinct l65> prompt appears

rows.action: At l65>, slowly enter exactly a(a(a(a( without Return. Count every character attempt; each Shift+8 chord counts as one queue event; repeat only if a character is not visible; remain below 256.
rows.expect: all eight intended characters are visible and the attempt count is recorded

rows.action: stop once and read raw/seen/stored/taken at $BCFC..$BCFF; if equal, cold reboot the same media before continuing
rows.expect: attempts = raw = seen = stored = taken; any inequality stops the contact

rows.action: re-enter Comfort, observe l65>, provoke TOKEN_TOO_LONG, then observe recovery
rows.expect: l65> marks Comfort entry; clean recovery shows native lisp65>. The documented retired-window red frame is pre-existing v1.7 freight, not a v1.6 blocker; cold reboot after it. Any different failure stops.

rows.action: type (list 1 3), move left twice, insert 2 followed by a space
exercise Left/Right, C-b/C-f, C-a/C-e, Delete and C-d including boundaries
rows.expect: cursor editing preserves order, inserts rather than overwrites, and boundary no-ops are safe

rows.action: submit (+ 10 on line one and 32) on line two
rapidly enter (+ 1, then five continuation comment lines each with a visually checked 40-digit 0123456789 pattern, then 2), without observation pauses
rows.expect: every digit remains ordered and the result is 3

rows.action: with Shift-Lock off, type and inspect a lowercase alphabetic form
rows.expect: lowercase remains lowercase on screen and in the result

rows.action: type a rapid sentence-length burst, pause once, then edit its middle
